products.label: CockroachDB
products.name: cockroachdb
products.short_description: Cloud-native distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL compatibility
products.long_description: CockroachDB is a distributed SQL database built on a transactional and strongly-consistent key-value store. It scales horizontally, survives disk, machine, rack, and even datacenter failures with minimal latency disruption and no manual intervention. CockroachDB provides familiar PostgreSQL-compatible SQL with ACID guarantees, making it easy to build resilient, cloud-native applications.
products.support_details: Community support available via GitHub (https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach), Slack (https://cockroachdb.slack.com), and Forum (https://forum.cockroachlabs.com). Commercial support available through Cockroach Labs: https://www.cockroachlabs.com/pricing/

features.title: Distributed SQL
features.description: Familiar PostgreSQL-compatible SQL interface with full ACID guarantees across a distributed system

features.title: Horizontal Scalability
features.description: Seamlessly scale from a few nodes to hundreds or thousands without application changes

features.title: Built-in Survivability
features.description: Automatic replication, repair, and rebalancing with no data loss and minimal downtime

features.title: Cloud Native Architecture
features.description: Deploy anywhere - on-premises, public cloud, private cloud, or hybrid environments

features.title: Multi-Region Deployment
features.description: Configure data placement for compliance and performance with geo-partitioning

features.title: Strong Consistency
features.description: Serializable isolation level by default, ensuring data integrity across all nodes

flavors.label: Standard Download
flavors.name: default
flavors.short_description: Download CockroachDB binaries for installation on user-managed infrastructure
flavors.long_description: This configuration provides download URLs for CockroachDB binaries across multiple platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) with configurable version selection. Suitable for users who want to install CockroachDB on their own infrastructure, whether on-premises, in IBM Cloud, or in other cloud environments.

features.title: Multi-Platform Support
features.description: Support for Linux (x86_64, ARM64), macOS, and Windows platforms

features.title: Version Selection
features.description: Choose from current stable, previous stable, or LTS versions

features.title: Checksum Verification
features.description: SHA256 checksums provided for all downloads to ensure binary integrity
